newsitem.title: USA: Clint Eastwood, new bride expect a baby.
newsitem.headline: Clint Eastwood, new bride expect a baby.

text.p: Tough-guy movie star Clint Eastwood and his new bride are expecting a baby early next year, his wife says.
Eastwood's wife, television news anchor Dina Ruiz, on Wednesday confirmed media reports that she is in her sixth month of pregnancy.
"It's a honeymoon baby," she said. "Clint and I are both really excited. We always planned to have one, I just didn't know it would be nine months after we got married."
The couple does not know if the baby will be a boy or a girl, she said.
Eastwood, 66, and Ruiz, 30, were married on March 31 at a private ceremony at the Las Vegas home of casino magnate Steve Wynn. They honeymooned in Hawaii.
It will be the first child for Ruiz, who anchors the news at the KSBW television station in Salinas, about 100 miles (160 km) south of San Francisco.

Actor and director Eastwood is famous for tough-guy roles in movies such as "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly" and the "Dirty Harry" series. He had two children -- actor Kyle Eastwood and model Alison Eastwood -- with his former wife Maggie. In 1993 he had a child with actress Frances Fisher, a co-star in his 1992 Oscar-winning film, "Unforgiven."
Ruiz said she planned to continue her television career during her pregnancy and after giving birth. "Clint's going to be the babysitter," she said. "His wife will be working five days a week."
